```yaml
name: Deploy Docker Image

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Deployment environment'
        required: true
        default: 'staging'
        type: choice
        options:
          - staging
          - production

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: doezer/questarr
          tags: |
            type=sha,format=short
            type=raw,value=latest,enable=${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}

      - name: Build and push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      - name: Deploy to environment
        run: |
          echo "Deploying to ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }} environment"
          echo "Image tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}"
          
          # For production, we might want to add specific deployment logic here
          # such as updating a Kubernetes deployment or triggering a server restart
          if [[ "${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}" == "production" ]]; then
            echo "Production deployment logic would go here"
          else
            echo "Staging deployment logic would go here"
          fi
```
